description.value:
You always know when your own constellation is ascendant and what its aspect is. You know nothing of the other twelve.

When the day's sign is your Cloth's, you gain a boon for the whole day:

  • Ascendant (any aspect): you gain your Cloth's Ascendant Boon.
  • Exalted: you gain your Cloth's Zenith Boon instead.

The sky's position wakes the Cloth; its energy only decides which boon you get. A Saint stands untouched in a Malefic sky while everyone around them suffers — and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Unfailing Cosmo] guarantees it.

Odds: Ascendant 1 in 13 (7.69%); Zenith 1 in 260 (0.385%). A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, not rolled — that scene is the whole class.
